svg.title: Saarthi causal feature and temporal model pipeline
svg.desc: Eighteen possible channels are assembled into a causal time window, encoded by modality-specific Conv1D and GRU branches, fused, and sent to present and forecast heads.

svg.text: The model never sees a single image in isolation
It sees a causal history of interpretable signals; optional modalities can disappear without changing the core schema.
Causal means every feature at time t uses only samples at or before t. That rule applies to rolling features and CAN alignment.
